title: Dragon feels his late father's presence on the ranch

tellings.quote: he's had experiences on the property where he's felt his father's presence,

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that a man called Bryant "Dragon" Arnold has had experiences there. According to Fugal, Arnold says he has felt the presence of his late father on the property. If true, it would add to the idea that the ranch touches on something beyond the physical.
